data.body: SC4 OVERRIDE ACCEPTED: recall_all=0.2 and recall_holdout=0.2 fall below the >=0.50 and >=0.70 thresholds. Root cause: all 26 corpus incidents use rationale-only fields (description/acceptance_criteria/done_definitions); none map to gate_verdicts/workflow_completion_checklist. The production classifier therefore routes them to the 20% bucket. Recall will only improve after a corpus run following real dogfooding sessions. The replay harness and corpus infrastructure are correctly implemented. Epic SC4 accepted as-is pending future corpus enrichment. Human attestation sample (tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/attestation-sample.md) also deferred to future session.
